Using the correct digit representation,
\[
\text{Digits}=10^6D+10^4H+10^2M+S.
\]
Thus
\[
\text{Digits}-T=(10^6D+10^4H+10^2M+S)-(86400D+3600H+60M+S)
\]
\[
=913600D+6400H+40M=40(22840D+160H+M).
\]
So \(40\) always divides the result.

It cannot be larger, because for \(D=0,H=0,M=1,S=0\), the time is \(60\) seconds, the digit representation is \(100\), and Bob computes \(100-60=40\).

\boxed{40}
